title: Polynomial-time equality test
statement: For every fixed bit string $w$, the function that maps a bit string $x$ to the one-bit word $[1]$ if $x=w$ and to the one-bit word $[0]$ otherwise is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: For every fixed bit string $w$, the function sending a bit string $x$ to the single bit that is $1$ if $x = w$ and $0$ otherwise is polynomial-time computable.
